entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week. It's for a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered nine days ago. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference thing. The online pictures made the color look like a matte gray, but in person, it's much shinier than I expected. The box is unopened, and I haven't even tried it on. I know safety is the most important thing for a helmet, but the look just isn't for me.

I understand completely. Getting the right color and finish is important. Since the delivery was only nine days ago, it's well within our 90-day return policy. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you.

That's great, thank you. I do have one small question. Since I have to go through the trouble of repackaging it and dropping it off for shipping, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase? Maybe 10%?

I appreciate you asking. While I can't offer a discount code for a return based on preference, I can confirm that the return shipping label I'm sending you is completely prepaid. There will be no cost to you to send the helmet back to us.
Okay, that's fair. A prepaid label works. Thank you for checking on that for me.

You're very welcome. I've just sent the prepaid return label and instructions to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any UPS location. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
